M15 — 2026-10-09
A stable patch can reuse the previous release's native cores without CI: `npm pack @sofar.sh/core-<plat>@<prev>` for all five, extract each binary into DIR/<rust-target>/, run `node packaging/npm/emit.mjs --binaries DIR`, then pack. The 0.34.2 tarballs proved the build reproducible: next to 0.34.1, only version strings differed.
